Mamaea Awakened
The latest rumors in Gnisis are about the rediscovery of the ancient caverns of Mamaea by the Imperial Cult. I was told I could speak with Chaplain Ogrul in Fort Darius to learn more.
Chaplain Ogrul asked me to speak with Baladas Demnevanni to help dispel the illusion hiding Mamaea.
Baladas said something is going on in the Gnisis Temple and that I should head there immediately.

The Sixth House attacked the Temple in Gnisis and stole the Ashmask of Vivec. I should return to Baladas. I need to find the entrance to Mamaea more than ever now. The awakening of Mamaea and this attack may be linked.
Baladas gave me an enchanted artifact which will lead me to Mamaea. I have no idea how he managed this, but he must have been preparing before I ever spoke with him... Telvanni and their secrets.
I have revealed the entrance to Mamaea.

A priestess of the Sixth House claims that the cavern of Mamaea lies atop an ancient stronghold. And that "only the eye of Mamaea can see the entrance". I must find the entrance to find the Ashmask of Vivec.
I have retrieved the ashmask of Vivec from Dagoth Araynys. I should return it to its shrine in the Temple and let Chaplain Ogrul know of the fate of the legionnaires.
I have placed  Vivec's Ashmask back in its shrine in Gnisis. I should go and tell Chaplain Ogrul about everything that's happened.

Chaplain Ogrul was extremely grateful for my assistance and offered to bless me in the name of the Nine Divines for my service. No amount of accolades will protect my dreams from the horror of Mamaea, but I appreciate his gesture.

I've heard that the location of the lost caverns of Mamaea has been discovered by the Imperial Cult. The tales of great treasures within Mamaea has led many an adventurer on a wild kagouti chase across the gash from East to West. You should speak with Chaplain Ogrul in Fort Darius if you're interested.
I'm putting in for reassignment after this.
You found Jeanne? Excellent. I'm sure she'll be around shortly to help me back to Gnisis.
Good to see you're still alive at least!
Who are you? Have you seen my captain?
Found anything yet?
You killed him! He's been there in some sort of trance since I found the place, worshipping that bloody statue. I don't even think he knew I was here. Did the legion send you?

Psst. Over here. Quietly. He seems to be in a trance. All he does is worship that bloody statue. He doesn't bother me and I don't bother him. As soon as I heal or my rations run out I'm going to try to return to the garrison at Gnisis and report finding this place. Whatever it is. Ai. You have no idea how good it is to see a normal face again.

I greet you in the name of Lord Dagoth and in the name of battle. You don't truly think that the mask of the betrayer is with me? I am but a captain among my Lord's closest brethren. Dagoth Araynys is Lord Dagoth's brother in the heart. He discovered that Mamaea, in its fever, buried an entire fortress in its death throws while pierced by the betrayer. But you will never reach him there. Only the eye of Mamaea can see the entrance.
This attack will not go unanswered! The Sixth House will pay for what they have done here.
Take shelter, citizen. The Temple is under attack. The Legion has no jurisdiction on Temple grounds, but we will sort out any cultists which spill into the streets.
The Temple is under attack! How can this be?

Are you now? Well, well. That is sad. For you in your delusion, or for my brother in his heartbreak, I know not which. It was a gross betrayal, Nerevar. But this conversation grows tiresome. I have much to do, and little enough time before the reckoning. And you will not be swayed from your purpose, I think. So ask. Who was Mamaea? What was Samsirano? Why did we steal away Vehk's Ash Mask? Or simply strike me and get on with it. You are the challenger, and to you goes the first blow.

Thank you. It is always good to have one's efforts appreciated. And by such a critic! But this conversation grows tiresome. I have much to do, and little enough time before the reckoning. And you will not be swayed from your purpose, I think. So ask. Who was Mamaea? What was Samsirano? Why did we steal away Vehk's Ash Mask? Or simply strike me and have done with it. You are the challenger, and to you goes the first blow.

Ah, come now. You did so well with the tests, I thought you better than that. You cannot sense the discord, the subtle ways your surroundings sing out of tune? I pity you. But this conversation grows tiresome. I have much to do, and little enough time before the reckoning. And you will not be swayed from your purpose, I think. So ask. Who was Mamaea? What was Samsirano? Why did we steal away Vehk's Ash Mask? Or simply strike me and have done with it. You are the challenger, and to you goes the first blow.

Indeed? A connoisseur, are we? Well, perhaps you are. But this conversation grows tiresome. I have much to do, and little enough time before the reckoning. And you will not be swayed from your purpose, I think. So ask. Who was Mamaea? What was Samsirano? Why did we steal away Vehk's Ash Mask? Or simply strike me and have done with it. You are the challenger, and to you goes the first blow.

So. You are the one my brother Voryn calls Nerevar. No, say nothing. I do not care if you truly are the Hortator. His time is gone. But you... You've done well to come this far. Did you like my little tests? They weren't for you, you know. My children are devoted, but sometimes they lack understanding of the sublime. They think in the straight lines of the mundane, when they need to be guided by the chords of the Song.
I'm ready whenever you are. I don't think we have anything to talk about, do we? Then let's get on with it. To you goes the first blow.

Samsirano, the Guardian of the Samsi. Resdayn did not always look as she does today, Nerevar. In times gone by the seas were lower, and the River Samsi a great trade route, and this stronghold watched over it. My brother Gilvoth called it home once. But he is called to higher things under Red Mountain, and it is I who tend my flock here now.

You cannot guess? The Mask shielded Gnisis from us. It sang a song that drowned out ours. No more. Now Gnisis is rendered open to our power, and all the world knows that ALMSIVI could do nothing to stop us, though we sent but the least of our servants. And, of course, the Mask is imbued with Vehk's power. I thought perhaps to find a way to strike at him directly through it.

So he's still alive. I'm lucky I am. I have no idea how I got here. I was just leaning against the wall to take a breather and the next thing I knew I was in here! Illusion magic is afoot I believe. I've checked the place out a little and all I could find was this Ash statue. It's no good to me but if you want it as a souvenir, if you get out that is. Here. Take it. I must get back to my captain.

Well, I've looked at them a thousand times and that's all I can get out of it. If you can make any sense of it then be my guest. I just want this leg to heal enough so I can get back to Gnisis and report this.

Here. You're welcome to these. Good luck and be careful. If you find Jeane, let her know where I am, and she can help me to get back. I'll just rest up 'til then. Don't think I'd be much help to you in this state.

Statues. Those insane writings I gave you suggest that there are statues in here that unlock the doors.

If you find Jeane, let her know where I am, and she can help me to get back. I'll just rest up 'til then. Don't think I'd be much help to you in this state.

Statues. These insane writings I found suggest that there are statues in here that unlock the doors. Listen to this;

"Forged from the mountain of red"
"As still as the thoughts in your head"
"In magic they're smocked"
"And all shall stay locked"
"Until they return to their bed"

See?

Lost her. And I don't mean dead. I mean I lost her in here somewhere. Most of the doors are locked and sealed with what appears to be magic so we split up. I took the long corridor but there was a corprus beast. I managed to kill it but my leg see. It scratched it. Seems to be infected with something and it's become so sore I can hardly move. Since I've been here though I did piece together some of the notes that I found lying around and I think I know how to unlock the doors.

There were five of us originally, sent to check the caves. We had... no idea. Who could expect it? I lost three of my men in there. We were overwhelmed. We ran like Oblivion and came across this place. It looks like it was unearthed recently. A lost stronghold, like the ones they have up and down the coast. That's something write home about, if I ever get out of here.
I see that my artifact was useful, %PCName. House Telvanni and myself, personally, have an interest in the remains of Mamaea. I thank you for your indirect assistance.

I expect that the den of cultists will be fully cleansed soon. But it is obviously a touchy area between the Great Houses, Tribunal Temple, and Empire. It will take time to see how it will be addressed. I hope you fare well, %PCName.
Then I bless you in the name of Akatosh, Arkay, Dibella, Julianos, Kynareth, Mara, Stendarr, Talos, and Zenithar. Fare you well, %PCName.
Of course, %PCName. You are truly a hero of our time and I wish you success in all your endeavors.

Thank you for investigating the Mamaea issue, %PCName. I can hardly believe the tale, and yet it is all as the Oracle foretold. A great danger has been averted, I think. Your services have been invaluable to the Empire and to this town. I can't offer you much in the way of a reward, but please allow me to bless you in the name of the Nine.

You have returned from Mamaea! I want you to tell me everything that happened, but first, you must return the Ash Mask to the Temple shrine. I don't want to get involved with any stolen Dunmer artifacts.

AE AMAM - this beautiful unrotting hulk. Isn't she splendid? Vehk's daughter by Bal, or so they would have you think. In truth I do not know. We slumbered long beneath Red Mountain, and much passed us by in that time. But if it were true, if she were flesh of Vehk's flesh, and flesh of OUR flesh? Ah. Now you see, I hope.

Mamaea - AE AMAM - this spawn of love is awakening. Have you not seen its marrow? Its godly substance is succor to my flesh. Its sickness is fortitude to my mind. You are a parasite in its body and must be expunged.
Baladas gave you an artifact to help you find the entrance and dispel the illusion? Wondeful! Please do make haste, %PCName.
Didn't you hear? The Tribunal Temple is under attack!
Must I explain this again? You must find Mamaea to stop the attacks. Try to put on the artifact I gave you to find the entrance and dispel the illusion.

Yes, I am not surprised that their target was the Ash Mask. It is a powerful artifact said to have protected this village from the blight. I wonder if the Sixth House was behind the blighting of the kwama queen as well. Nonetheless, yes, I will help you dispel the illusion which hides Mamaea. It's simpler than you might think. At least for one of my talents. I already prepared an object which will do the work for you. Here, take this and it will lead you to Mamaea. Simply try to put it around your neck.
No time, %PCName. Go to the Temple.
I can help with the illusion, %PCRank, but first, hurry to the Temple. I detected certain foreboding intrusions just manifest there.
I'd *love* to help you with this, but I think there are more pressing events proceeding, %PCName. A commotion down in the Temple. Best hop along, errand runner.
Please speak with Baladas Demnevanni. His tower is called "Arvs-Drelun" and is on the outskirts of Gnisis.
I have heard that Baladas is an esteemed wizard among the Telvanni and I imagine that he would be able to sniff out the illusion. He lives in the old wizard tower on the edge of town.
Please return if you change your mind.

If it wasn't already obvious, I am rather desperate to reconcile this disaster. I was hoping someone like yourself would come to help. Political complications don't allow me to be seen fraternizing with the Great Houses with regard to Imperial affairs. But an outsider such as you can act in my stead. Can you please speak with the Telvanni wizard, Baladas Demnevanni?
Of course, %PCRace. May the Nine watch over you.

Ah, I see you've heard the rumors. Yes, the Oracle did see a vision about a cave of "bone and blood". The Cult engaged the Legion and five troopers were dispatched to investigate the area but never returned. One was found east of the River Samsi, delirious. All he could tell us before he died was "They're coming for 'it'." Subsequent squads reported not finding any entrance to a cave or trace of them whatsoever. I suspect an illusion may be hiding the entrance, but it is beyond my skill to dispel.

Only because you are my friend, %PCName, will I talk of it. Mamaea is an old name, older than this town, older even than Old Baladas in his tower. If the legends are true, it was a monster spawned by the joining of Vivec and the Lord of Rape, Molag Bal. It was a monster of horror and is said to have contributed to the creation of "The Gash" in both the East and West. Vivec slew the monster and all of the other unnatural spawn from that joining as a lesson for us in just action.

"Mamaea" was the name of a monster which once terrorized this area. That legend is tied to the creation of the region we now call the "West Gash". Purportedly that monster was the result of a union between Vivec and Molag Bal, but no-one has ever been able to confirm it. Of course, a believer needs no more confirmation than what is said in the Sermons. Naturally.
Mamea is taboo, %PCName. We do not speak of that ancient evil.
I heard a monster died there. The Dunmer are dreadfully superstitious about it.
